status_reason: The pilot is ready for review; rollout remains dependent on a security decision due November 10.
summary: The team completed the pilot workflow and verified recovery from interrupted sessions. This removes two readiness gaps for the planned rollout. Access-policy approval remains open, so the launch date is not yet confirmed.

accomplishments.title: Pilot workflow ready for review
accomplishments.detail: The end-to-end onboarding flow passed acceptance checks on October 28. It is implemented and verified in the pilot environment; production deployment is still pending.

accomplishments.title: Interrupted sessions can recover
accomplishments.detail: Recovery behavior passed the agreed verification on November 3, reducing a known risk to pilot continuity. No production reliability improvement has been measured yet.

risks.title: Access approval holds the rollout
risks.detail: The security review remains open. The team can continue pilot validation while the reviewer resolves the access policy; a decision after November 10 could move the rollout window.

next_steps.title: Confirm rollout readiness
next_steps.detail: Complete access review and run the final pilot checklist. This is planned work, dependent on approval.

decisions.title: Approve the pilot access policy
decisions.detail: Leadership needs to accept the proposed access scope or request changes before rollout scheduling. Delaying the choice leaves the launch date unconfirmed.

metrics.label: Verified pilot outcomes
metrics.definition: Two distinct leaf outcomes accepted during this period. Parent tickets, administrative closures, and deployments are excluded.
